name: Short sword
description: Quick, handy and forgiving in doorways. Its owner was never the tallest, and was proud of it.
notes: A one-handed sword; reuses the arming sword move set (no sword moves of its own yet). Catalogue tier common (economy doc, swords 60-140). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
